V01.criterion_target_quote: **Immediate identity.** The creature reads as the established MurderBird without labels, cage scenery or audio. No cute mascot, crow, dinosaur or borrowed robot identity.

V02.criterion_target_quote: **Whole-body silhouette and mass.** Match head-to-body ratio, breast depth/taper, shoulder width, pelvis, leg exposure and compact rear contour to scoped era references. Bulk remains avian and the curved neck remains visible.

V03.criterion_target_quote: **Head, bill and mandible.** Match deep convex hooked bill, tip curvature, jaw silhouette, cheek negative space and head mass; avoid flat wedge, thin arc or cute rounded beak.

V04.criterion_target_quote: **Crown, optic and facial character.** Match swept segmented crown, circular recessed housing, relative eye scale and facial severity; powered optic belongs only where era evidence allows.

V05.criterion_target_quote: **Neck, shoulder and breast relationship.** Preserve strong curved plated neck, clearance beneath bill, natural attachment and reference breast transition; neither straight stack nor hidden neck.

V06.criterion_target_quote: **Folded mantle and wings.** Match compact broad layered folded contour around shoulder/elbow; recognizable avian shields, not exposed human arms, flying wings or a hanging train.

V07.criterion_target_quote: **Legs, feet and talons.** Match substantial mechanical legs, stance, joint placement, toe separation, claw curvature and grounded foot silhouette. No spindly limbs, toy toes or invented dinosaur proportions.

V08.criterion_target_quote: **Regional plate geometry.** Match plate hierarchy, size variation, overlap, thickness cues, seams and fastening rhythm per region; no repetitive barrel bands or uniform feather texture substitute.

V09.criterion_target_quote: **Era material twin.** Match era-specific bronze, dark recesses, patina, repairs and modern detail; control roughness, relief and reflections without repainting away shape errors.

V10.criterion_target_quote: **Inherited individual and asymmetry.** Same recognizable individual across eras; anatomical left restriction and documented repair history persist at appropriate dates without mirroring or unsupported chronology.

V11.criterion_target_quote: **View continuity.** Front, both sides, rear, three-quarter, elevated and low views form one coherent body; unseen reconstruction does not contradict supported silhouettes.

V12.criterion_target_quote: **Motion continuity with imagery and footage.** Identity remains stable frame-to-frame through required era actions; no morphing, changing plates/toes, rubber metal or shape collapse. Compare scoped source footage at identified timecodes.

V13.criterion_target_quote: **Restored exterior after inspection.** Opening reveals the same assembly; closure restores reference proportions, overlaps, seams and attachments exactly, without cumulative drift.

V14.criterion_target_quote: **Identity throughout presentation.** Main exhibit, era thumbnails, fallback, folio, sharing cards and icons use the correct scoped MurderBird family; artwork never masquerades as live model evidence.

B01.criterion_target_quote: **Anchored unpowered rest.** No autonomous walking, pacing, tracking, attack or internally generated intention; the supported body stays fixed without input.

B02.criterion_target_quote: **External articulation.** Leg, wing/guard, compact tail, neck and mouth can be individually operated; visible rod/line/lever causality, bounded travel and supported return.

B03.criterion_target_quote: **Limited mechanical locomotion.** Slow short steps, rigid segmented turns, loading/release/settle/dwell and purposeful jerkiness follow a repeatable drive; no smooth Advanced gait.

B04.criterion_target_quote: **Finite drive without cognition.** Winding/energy limits and stop behavior are coherent; no target tracking, tactical attack, independent modern heart/brain or Advanced power move.

B05.criterion_target_quote: **Living waiting behavior.** Sustained agitation and frustrated confinement, pacing, attention shifts, cage testing and brief intentional stillness; no predominantly inert turntable or obvious short repeated pantomime.

B06.criterion_target_quote: **Directed threat response.** Notice, orient, approach, warning/anticipation, strike/snap, bounded contact, recovery and cooldown respond to visitor target and retreat.

B07.criterion_target_quote: **Claw and enclosure actions.** Purposeful claw/talon grip, scrape or strike and body/guard pressure communicate frustrated cage testing; a beak-only response does not complete the original claw request.

B08.criterion_target_quote: **Mass, speed and coordination.** Fast fluid intent with anticipation, momentum, grounded support, foot lift/placement, acceleration, braking and articulated turns; no sliding root or weightless teleport.

B09.criterion_target_quote: **Jump and shield thrust.** Distinct leg-powered jump/controlled landing and compact planted shoulder/elbow shove demonstrate power; left restriction remains and wings never provide flight.

B10.criterion_target_quote: **Transitions and cancellation.** Era change, pause, reduced motion, inspection and reset preserve a valid supported state; no queued stale attacks, snap-to-origin or permanent stuck pose.

B11.criterion_target_quote: **Separate power and mental persona.** Abundant fictional encounter power has no routine refuel/depletion; sensing and processing express awareness independently. Local behavior must not be advertised as demonstrated learning AI.

C01.criterion_target_quote: **Exterior follows corrected structure.** Frame proportions and pivots support the reference silhouette before armor completion; covering cannot hide a rejected structure or invented joint.

C02.criterion_target_quote: **Regional mechanical anatomy.** Head/jaw, neck, breast/frame, pelvis, shoulders/elbows, legs/feet and rear have specific structural, transmission and covering roles appropriate to era.

C03.criterion_target_quote: **Rigid versus flexible ownership.** Metal plates/rails rotate rigidly; sliding links and genuinely flexible elements behave according to role and stay attached. No stretched armor, floating pins or blended joints.

C04.criterion_target_quote: **Clearance and ground support.** No material armor/joint/body/cage intersections in required motions; feet and cradle provide credible support and movement stays within bounds.

C05.criterion_target_quote: **Chronological system eligibility.** Maker passive/external-only; Mechanic distinct drive and repair; Advanced selective actuators/sensors/power/processor. Components genuinely absent when ineligible, not merely darkened.

C06.criterion_target_quote: **Meaningful cavities and mechanisms.** Openings expose credible proposed assemblies and spatial relationships, not a solid lump, decorative unrelated gears or modern machinery inside Maker.

C07.criterion_target_quote: **Power and processing segregation.** Power housed in breast and cranial processing separately legible, inspectable and connected plausibly; no franchise reactor or implied biological organ.

C08.criterion_target_quote: **Inspection and assembly restoration.** Supported stable opening, adjustable exploded separation, readable attachment relationships and exact reassembly; no detonation, gore or stretched connectors.

C09.criterion_target_quote: **Material history and service logic.** Regional wear, patina, tool marks and repair hardware follow chronology, seams/contact/exposure and readable service access; no universal noise coat.

C10.criterion_target_quote: **Editable deliverable and runtime equivalence.** Versioned editable source, stable moving assemblies, export and browser view agree; model and procedural mechanisms both documented and reproducible.

I01.criterion_target_quote: **Spatial exploration.** Orbit/fly-around experience, zoom, sensible bounds, reset and camera alternatives reveal the whole creature without entering walls or losing it; one good orbit solution satisfies the original either/or.

I02.criterion_target_quote: **Enclosure legibility.** Readable imaginary containment with proper scale and contact boundaries; cage is a separable exhibit fixture, not invented story evidence or a visual obstruction.

I03.criterion_target_quote: **Reach and retreat affordance.** Clear deliberate input and equivalent keyboard/touch path address a visible virtual target; ordinary camera orbit must not accidentally trigger attack.

I04.criterion_target_quote: **Regional selection and explanation.** Named selectable regions/hotspots, readable explanation, selected-state feedback and centering reveal what matters; descriptions match the selected era and actual assembly.

I05.criterion_target_quote: **Understandable era switching.** Visitors immediately understand era, construction and capability changes; unavailable actions are absent/clearly explained, and switching preserves appropriate user preferences.

I06.criterion_target_quote: **Reversible visitor journey.** Observe → interact → settle → inspect → separate → reassemble → resume is discoverable, recoverable and free of forced cinematic/scroll interruptions.

A01.criterion_target_quote: **Calm and reduced motion.** Pause/calm and reduced-motion alternatives remain usable; reduced motion avoids aggressive travel/jump while preserving explanations and meaningful feedback.

A02.criterion_target_quote: **Keyboard, touch and readable controls.** Essential tasks have usable keyboard/touch equivalents, visible focus, meaningful labels/status, legible text and small-screen layout without trapping or hiding controls.

A03.criterion_target_quote: **Honest fallback and recovery.** Model/WebGL/media failure yields useful clearly labeled still/schematic/text experience and retry; correct era assets render and no fallback is scored as 3D evidence.

A04.criterion_target_quote: **Optional approved audio.** Accepted Iron Verdict v3 full/loop player, lyrics, pause/restart/mute/volume and explicit play; no autoplay or competing soundscape; legacy instrumentals distinctly labeled.

A05.criterion_target_quote: **Story and video continuity.** Scoped story images and reviewed silent clip remain accessible, properly labeled and visitor-controlled; original fiction, proposed internals and cage encounter remain distinguishable.

A06.criterion_target_quote: **Responsive real-time presentation.** Character remains readable and interactive at agreed desktop/mobile sizes, with honest loading/error status and measured performance on named devices.

D01.criterion_target_quote: **One release identity.** GitHub main, exact successful CI/Pages run, runtime model and delivered files agree; local/review/history are clearly separated from current release.

D02.criterion_target_quote: **Source preservation and custody.** Original images/videos/story/source projects and provenance preserved; no private archives, sessions, credentials or unapproved source exposed to browser output.

D03.criterion_target_quote: **Tools, rights and architecture discipline.** Existing Vite/Three/Web Audio architecture maintained unless separately scoped; reputable tools, appropriate licenses, no unauthorized purchase/upload/dependency/migration or Replit publication.

D04.criterion_target_quote: **Documentation and consistent identity.** README, metadata, social card, favicons and pinned-app assets represent the same product and scope; no unrelated-project content, stale availability claim or false final approval.

D05.criterion_target_quote: **Reproducible evidence and limitations.** Source/native/export/runtime and automated/human checks are distinguishable; exact files, environments, recordings and unresolved discrepancies support every consequential score.
